query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM published_paths p
                JOIN blob_objects b ON b.id = p.blob_object_id
                JOIN caches c ON c.id = p.cache_id
                WHERE c.is_public
                    AND b.file_hash = $1
                    AND b.compression = $2
                    AND EXISTS (
                        SELECT 1
                        FROM cache_protocols cp
                        WHERE cp.cache_id = c.id
                            AND cp.protocol = 'nix'
                    )
            ) AS "exists!"
